title: Visual builder Layers drag, TRBL spacing, CSS patch, module catalog

entries.summary: Layers tree supports HTML5 drag-reorder using the same applyReorder as the canvas. Modules can drop onto another column in the tree.
Padding and margin are four-side fields. Stored value remains a CSS shorthand string so backup and public CSS stay compatible.
Live CSS patches only the selected node’s rules. Module picker hints are loaded from LayoutBuilder::moduleCatalog() via data-modules.
No schema change. Spacing is still padding/margin strings in layout_json; compiled CSS is derived.
cms-builder-drag-column-size asserts Layers rows are draggable, four-sided padding in the stylesheet, hover, and content patch.
